ar_6_o_o_s_wall.blurb: O.O.S. Wall is the final section of Capitol Crag, in the Crystal Bluff climbing area of central Arkansas. It sits up on the hillside beyond most of the crag, and the cliff runs off to the right once you reach it. All twelve routes are bolted sport lines, and the grades are friendly: a couple of 5.7s and 5.8s, mostly 5.9, and a handful of 5.10s, with nothing harder. That makes it a good stop for newer leaders or anyone wanting an easy warm-up day after the steeper walls elsewhere on the crag. The routes use a mix of climbing styles rather than one repeated pattern, so expect slab, vertical and a bit of ledgy movement.
